sections.title: Improved
items: Minor improvements and bug fixes.

sections.title: Acknowledgements
items: Added Malte Ostendorff to Thanks.

sections.title: Fixes
items: URLs spanning full-width terminal rows are recognised and underlined as one link, including when hovering over a continuation row.

sections.title: Added
items: Up to nine split panes per tab.
Maximise the active pane with Command+Shift+Return, then restore the original split layout.
Read release notes from Help → What’s New?.
Open the online documentation from the Help menu.

sections.title: Improved
items: The dark app icon is now the default.
Animated backgrounds pause when windows are fully covered or hidden, or the desktop is inactive.
Animated backgrounds present directly through Metal, reducing CPU use while keeping the same colours and motion.
Build identifiers show the source commit.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Option-key typing uses the macOS keyboard layout by default, including # and € on British keyboards. Option as Meta remains available in Settings.
Option+Left and Option+Right move between shell words with native Option typing enabled.
Recovered sessions stay hidden behind a restoration indicator until ready, then restore keyboard focus without interrupting search input.
New windows receive keyboard focus immediately and accept typing while the shell starts.

sections.title: Withdrawn
items: Replaced by Moth 0.27.2.

sections.title: First public release
items: Native macOS windows with tabs, split panes, and saved window layouts.
Named profiles for appearance and session defaults, with live-reloading TOML configuration.
Snippet and recorded macros, configurable shortcuts, and regular-expression search.
Sixel images, 24-bit truecolor, Nerd Fonts icons, and configurable VT double-width and double-height lines.
Wumpus Mono Pro with bold and italic styles, plus font and OpenType controls.
Configurable themes, ANSI palettes, cursors, background images, animated backgrounds, opacity, and frosted glass.
Local session recovery after an app crash, tab and pane transfers between windows, and URL opening.
Configurable bells and keyboard sounds, text encodings, scrollback export, printing, and update checks.
Signed and notarised for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later.
